'''Bufopel''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[humanoid]] [[species]] that lived in [[the galaxy]]. Some of them, known as the [[Bufopel Protector]]s, fought with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:SWC_Bufopel_Protector.png|thumb|left|200px|Bufopel were large-bodied humanoids]]
The Bufopel were a [[species]] of large-bodied [[Sentience|sentient]] [[humanoid]]s that were [[Color|pale pink]] in coloration,<ref name="Episode VIII">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> with two [[Limb|legs]] and two arms ended in stubby four-fingered hands. The species had no visible neck, instead having heads extruded from the upper portion of their thick, blubbery torsos, giving off the impression that they possessed a naturally hunched posture. These head was disproportionately small compared to their bodies, displaying small slanted eyes, tiny, exposed nostrils, and a large mouths that extended from one side of their face to the other. Bufopel could grow thick white [[hair]] that covered much of their body, portions of which extended along the face and jaw to form a distinct beard-like shape.<ref name="Chapter 19">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 19: The Convert}}</ref> The species' immense strength made them formidable opponents capable of taking extensive physical damage.<ref name="SWC" />

==Society and culture==
As a species, the Bufopel were usually considered peaceful. However, in case of conflict, they would not hesitate to unite and defend themselves.<ref name="SWC" /> The Bufopel's native [[language]] was also known as [[Bufopel (language)|Bufopel]].<ref name="SWKidsLanguages">{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Language in Star Wars Movies|video=CZp8Civk2co|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Bufopel in the galaxy==
In [[230 BBY]]<ref name="THRTOS3Date">The events of ''The High Republic: Trail of Shadows'' 3 take place concurrently with [[The High Republic Adventures (2021) 11|''The High Republic Adventures'' (2021) 11]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of to [[230 BBY]].</ref> a Bufopel and their [[Lukovel]] companion were present within [[Vaba Blanks Midnight Den]] located in the [[Steebark District]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], the two watched a live performance of a band that included a [[human]], a [[Harch]], an [[Amani]] and two [[Chadra-Fan]].<ref name="TOS 3">[[The High Republic: Trail of Shadows 3|''The High Republic: Trail of Shadows'' 3]]</ref>

[[File:RigfuUrcolla-TLJ.png|thumb|right|260px|The Bufopel gambler Rigfu Urcolla]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War]], a group of warriors known as [[Bufopel Protector]]s joined the ranks of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], a movement that sought to topple the [[Galactic Empire]] and restore [[democracy]] to [[the galaxy]].<ref name="SWC" /> In [[9 ABY]]<ref name="Mando19Date">{{MandoDate|19}}</ref> a Bufopel wearing a yellow sash rode on the same Coruscant [[hovertrain]] as [[Penn Pershing]], who was being guided by [[Elia Kane]] to [[Mission to retrieve the mobile lab station|retrieve a mobile lab station]]. Kane made small talk with the Bufopel, complaining about [[Taungsday|Taungsdays]], to which the Bufopel simply grunted in agreement.<ref name="Chapter 19" />

In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="EP8Date">{{FilmDate|VIII}}</ref> the Bufopel [[gambler]], [[Rigfu Urcolla]], was present in the [[Canto Bight]] [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|casino]] on the planet [[Cantonica]] when [[Resistance]] agents [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] arrived on their [[Mission to Canto Bight|mission]] to find the [[Master Codebreaker]]. At one point, Urcolla slammed his fists down onto a table in apparent frustration, disrupting and shaking the [[Troglof]] croupier [[Thamm]], who was sitting on it.<ref name="Episode VIII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bufopel first appeared in [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] directed by [[Rian Johnson]].<ref name="Episode VIII" /> Though not identified in the film itself, they were eventually named within the mobile game ''[[Star Wars: Commander]]''.<ref name="SWC" /> The Bufopel character Rigfu Urcolla was included in the ''Star Wars'' Sequel Skin Pack released for ''Minecraft''<ref name="Sequel Store">{{WebCite|url=https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/minecraft-star-wars-sequel-skin-pack/BTW74X3D2R8G|text=Buy ''Star Wars'' Sequel Skin Pack|work=Xbox|archiveurl=https://archive.md/rMJC1}}</ref> on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="TLJ Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref>
